notes_for_editor: Only the Tennessee list places this tower; no other source found describes a Reelfoot lookout. The name matches Reelfoot Lake, but no source ties the tower to the lake, so the story does not say where it stood beyond Obion County. No build, staffing, fire or removal date. Elevation 147 m and coordinates (36.3503, -89.3108) match the record and the tnlandforms waypoint OBT001. The name may be the list author's own (his note on unofficial names). The MPS CCC figure is regional background only.
